item.title: Exploring a fruit flys brain maleCNS project
item.description: Google recently open sourced the schematic of a flys brain its just the map not the wights and stuff its just a few weeks after its been released i think and people are already doing crazy things with it a fly has been trained to play chess like this and it has 700 elo. I love how it works and i made my own program to explore the mapping digram, ! I think its so cool to explore a brain like this !
